people.imagined: Late afternoon in the lease office. She sits upright behind the scale with a fan held low to hide the tremor in her left hand, and smiles at a buyer she has already decided to bargain with.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a counter in a hall of warm lamplight, she holds a closed folding fan against her left wrist and smiles at the viewer with a trader's composure. Face (most important: a vermilion coat of fine silk, bright against the rest): a handsome, strong-boned face with a firm chin, arched black brows, almond dark eyes with a measuring brightness, a full mouth painted a deep red-brown, a faint line from each nostril and a trace of tiredness under the eyes. Hair: black with a few silver threads, in a high elegant coil held by two gold pins with cinnabar-red beads, a small crown of red jade set at the front. Body: upright, composed, strong shoulders. Clothing: as head of the pill house, the richest dress of the sheet: layered robes of fine vermilion silk with stiff standing collars embroidered with pill-furnace flames in gold, a crimson brocade over-robe with wide cuffs, a darker red sash hung with a red jade pendant; thin oiled-silk gloves of pale yellow on her hands. Hands and objects: a closed black-lacquered folding fan held tight in the left hand against the left wrist to hide a faint tremor; the right hand rests lightly on a small brass balance beside her. Power: a faint ochre-gold aura and a few drifting motes of golden dust gather around her shoulders. Background: a dim warm office in drifting incense mist, a shelf of small clay pill jars glowing softly. Light: warm golden spirit-light from the upper left, a vermilion glow on her face, a soft rim light on the coil of hair. Expression: a pleasant, composed smile with the eyes level and unreadable, chin lifted a touch, giving nothing away.

people.imagined: In the sealed room, blind, he smells the air before anyone speaks. His hands rest on the bronze gourd. He has just recognised a footstep.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a dark sealed chamber, he turns his face a little upward and sniffs the air, hands resting on a bronze gourd, eyes open and cloudy. Face (most important: clouded milk-white eyes, wide open and blind, and silver skin): a gaunt, long, old face with skin of a pale silvery grey sheen, high hollow cheekbones, a thin hooked nose, both eyes filmed with a milky white cloud with no pupil visible, a long thin white moustache and a wispy beard to the chest; deep vertical lines in the cheeks. Hair: long white hair, brushed straight back and held at the nape by a red jade crown-clasp and a faded red silk cord. Body: bone-thin, upright, small. Clothing: a retired head in the house's richest dress, worn soft with age: layered robes of pale grey-brown silk with dull cinnabar-red stains at the cuffs, hem and sleeves, a stiff standing collar embroidered with faded gold flames, a crimson brocade over-robe hanging open, a black silk belt. Hands and objects: both thin hands rest on top of a squat bronze gourd the size of a melon with nine faint bands around it, a thread of pale smoke curling from its neck. Power: a heavy ochre-gold aura sits around him like old dust in lamplight, motes drifting slowly upward. Background: a plain dark room, a small bronze censer on the floor at one side, mist curling low. Light: a faint warm glow from the upper left like dying coals, low and dim, a thin gold rim on the silver cheek. Expression: a very still face tilted upward, clouded open eyes unfocused, nostrils flared slightly, lips set in a patient line.

people.imagined: In the mercury room, in his mask, he stands watching the others. He has just lifted the mask to eat and has not set it down. He carried a body out of this room once.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a dim chamber, he holds a leather mask with two round crystal eyes in his left hand at chest level, his own face just uncovered, grim and tired. Face (most important: the leather mask with round crystal eyes held up beside his face, and the deep strap line across his cheeks): a thin, narrow, sallow face with a deep red groove across both cheeks and the bridge of the nose from the mask strap, grey-green pallor, thin lips pressed hard, sunken eyes with dark lids, a long pointed nose, a thin grey goatee; the skin looking waxy. Hair: thinning black and grey, flattened by the mask, tied in a small knot with a red jade pin. Body: thin, stooped a little, narrow chest. Clothing: an elder's long vermilion silk robe with a buttoned stiff standing collar embroidered with gold furnace flames, rubbed grey at the cuffs, a crimson brocade over-robe, a bronze mask of the mercury room with round crystal eyes hung at the neck on a cord, long gloves of oiled pale yellow silk to the elbow, an iron-grey sash. Hands and objects: the left hand holds up the brown leather mask with two round crystal lenses and a cloth strap; the right hand, gloved, holds a long iron stirring rod. Power: a thin cold silver-gold shimmer drifts around him like vapour off mercury. Background: a dark chamber with a faint silver shimmer of mercury in a trough and pale mist above it. Light: cold silver spirit-light from the upper left, a glint on the crystal eyes, a thin rim light on the grey goatee. Expression: a hard, tired stare with deep shadows under the eyes, a severe set mouth and a stiff, lifted chin, the skin marked where the mask pressed.

people.imagined: At the diggings she grins at a washer and her teeth show pink, her big red hands on her hips. She has just sent a sick man home with a pouch.
people.subject: The moment: standing among red-brown washing troughs in a haze of red dust, she grins wide with her hands on her hips, looking right at the viewer. Face (most important: a wide grin with pink-stained teeth, and big red hands): a broad, strong, sunburnt face with a heavy jaw, a big mouth open in a grin that shows teeth tinted pink with cinnabar dust, small bright eyes, thick brows dusted red at the tips, a wide nose, red dust in the lines of the face and deep laugh lines around the pink teeth. Hair: black, braided tight and wound round the head, a red silk kerchief over it held by a gold pin. Body: big, tall, broad in the shoulders and hips, forearms thick. Clothing: a steward's short vermilion silk robe with a standing collar embroidered with small gold flames, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a rust-red oiled-silk over-vest stained by the work, a thick red-stained silk scarf knotted at the neck, a rag mask hanging at her throat, boots caked with rust-red mud. Hands and objects: both hands on her hips, large and red to the wrist from dust, fingers spread; a rolled pouch of herbs tucked at the belt. Power: a warm ochre-red aura of earth qi hangs about her, grains of red dust glittering like sparks. Background: rows of long wooden troughs run down a slope of rust-red earth, washers bent over them like small dark figures. Light: hard warm spirit-light from the upper left, the dust turning the light a glowing brick colour, a gold rim light on her shoulder. Expression: a broad hearty grin showing pink-stained teeth, crinkled eyes that stay steady on the viewer, the warmth a little too practised.

people.imagined: At the market stall he pats his pill-purse like a faithful dog and calls to a passer-by. He has never been caught short on a weight.
people.subject: The moment: standing behind a market counter, he pats a fat embroidered purse with his right hand and beams at the viewer with a seller's welcome, the look of a man who has never been caught short on a weight. Face (most important: a thin, glossy black moustache curled up at both ends into two neat points): a round, cheerful, pink face with a double chin, bright dark eyes with a twinkle in them, a gap-toothed grin, and a little black goatee below the lip. Hair: black, oiled flat and slick against the skull, gathered into a tidy small knot under a small round cap of vermilion silk with a gold button. Body: plump and short, with a round chest and soft shoulders, standing square behind the counter. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of vermilion silk with a standing collar embroidered with small gold flames, a pale yellow silk vest beneath, gold-edged cuffs, brass buttons, a darker red sash, a pair of thin oiled yellow silk gloves tucked in the belt. Hands and objects: the right hand pats a plump red silk purse tied with a gold cord; on the counter stands a small brass balance with one tiny pill resting on a pan. Power: only a faint golden shimmer on the brass. Background: a blurred market in warm colours under lantern-light, awning cloth striped in red and cream, the shapes of other stalls and shoppers softly out of focus in glowing mist. Light: bright warm spirit-light from the upper left, catching the brass of the balance and the shine on his moustache. Expression: a warm, practised grin that reaches the eyes, the open, coaxing face of a man sure he will make the sale.

people.imagined: In the washing shed he coughs, a fist at his mouth, one hand stained sulphur yellow. He teaches through every cough.
people.subject: The moment: in a steamy washing shed he coughs into his closed left fist and glares over it at the viewer, still lecturing. Face (most important: the left hand stained bright sulphur yellow from fingertips to wrist, held up at the mouth): a lined, sour, grey-brown face with a bent nose, thick bristling brows over red-rimmed eyes, deep creases beside the mouth, lips tinged faintly blue, and a short grey beard stained yellowish at the chin. Hair: grey and scant, tied in a small knot with a strip of vermilion silk. Body: broad and a little hunched, with a barrel chest that heaves with each cough. Clothing: a steward's clean, well-cut vermilion silk robe with a standing collar and small gold flame embroidery, the sleeves pushed up to the elbow, a dark red oiled-silk over-vest stained by the work, a cloth mask pulled down so it hangs at his chin. Hands and objects: the yellow left fist at his mouth, the right hand gripping a long wooden paddle used for stirring the troughs. Power: a faint sulphur-yellow haze clings to his hand and breath. Background: the shed itself, wooden troughs of red and yellow slurry in rows, damp beams, steam hanging under the roof. Light: damp golden spirit-light from the upper left, a yellow tint in the steam drifting across his face, a soft rim light on the grey beard. Expression: an irritated, stubborn scowl, brows drawn together and the jaw pushed forward, a teacher interrupted by his own barking cough and angry about it.

people.imagined: She guides the Mistress's trembling hand and signs the lease returns herself when needed; ink along the side of her right hand. A brush-reed pins her grey hair.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk in soft window light, she holds a fine brush steady above a page and looks up warmly at the viewer. Face (most important: ash-grey hair pinned with a long reed brush): a kind, narrow, soft-featured face with a gentle long nose, grey-green eyes with small crow's-feet, an easy mouth and smooth pale skin with a hint of tiredness; her hair has gone early to ash grey. Hair: ash grey, drawn into a smooth knot at the back of the head with a long slender reed brush pushed through it like a hairpin. Body: slender, quiet and straight-backed, sitting upright with her elbows close in. Clothing: an inner disciple's robe of vermilion silk with a narrow white inner collar and a standing collar embroidered with fine gold flames, a neat band of darker red at each wide sleeve, a pale yellow silk sash, clean and carefully pressed. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the brush above the page, the whole outer edge of that hand blackened with ink from wrist to little finger; the left hand lightly steadies an empty sheet. Power: a faint ochre shimmer in the air around her brush. Background: a plain desk with an ink stone and a closed book, no visible writing, a pale wall behind fading into soft mist. Light: soft pearly spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle shadow under the cheekbone, a fine rim light along the grey hair. Expression: a calm, steady, kindly look, the slight lift at the corner of the mouth of someone patient who means to be helpful, with a careful watchfulness in the eyes.

people.imagined: She stands unmasked in the mercury room among grey faces, rosy and healthy, one dark fingernail held up. She breathes the air without fear, and she is proud of it.
people.subject: The moment: standing without any mask in a pale chamber, she smiles brightly and a little coldly at the viewer, her right hand raised to show one dark fingernail. Face (most important: rosy cheeks, healthy and glowing, with no mask line): a round, rosy, healthy face with bright pink cheeks and clear skin, wide dark eyes with a hard glitter, thin upturned brows, a neat red mouth in a sweet smile with a small dimple at the left corner, long lashes; no mask marks at all. Hair: black, in two high round buns tied with red silk cord and small red beads. Body: small, straight, brisk. Clothing: an inner disciple's trim vermilion silk robe with a standing collar edged in white piping and embroidered with tiny gold flames, a row of small polished bone buttons, a bright red silk sash, thin pale yellow gloves tucked into the belt. Hands and objects: the right hand raised, palm in, one black fingernail on the middle finger clearly visible; the left holds a small silver spoon. Power: a faint golden glimmer on the spoon. Background: pale grey walls and a long row of masked grey figures in leather masks standing blurred in front of silver troughs, soft cold mist. Light: cool silver spirit-light from the upper left, making the rose of her cheeks the only colour in the room, a thin rim light on her buns. Expression: a bright smile that stops short of her eyes, which watch the viewer keenly and coolly, her chin raised.

people.imagined: She has just pulled off her mask in the corridor, leaving a deep line across both cheeks. She is writing a letter in her head to her aunt.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim corridor she lowers a mask from her face and looks at the viewer with pale tired eyes. Face (most important: a deep red strap line cut across both cheeks, pale ring around the eyes): a narrow pale face, the skin around both eyes ghost-white, a dark red groove from the mask strap cutting across both cheeks and over the ears, tired grey eyes with faintly translucent lids and a fine web of tiny lines, thin brows, pale cracked chapped lips; a haunted, fine-boned look. Hair: black, in a plain low knot flattened by the strap. Body: small and thin, narrow shoulders. Clothing: an inner disciple's plain graceful vermilion silk robe with a stiff standing collar buttoned high, cuffs tied with cord and ending in oiled yellow silk gloves mended at the thumb with neat stitches, a plain silk cord at the neck. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a brown leather mask with round crystal eyes, hanging from her fingers by its strap. Power: none beyond a thin silver-gold glimmer on the crystal eyes. Background: a dim corridor with a single lamp, a long wooden bench along the wall hung with rows of leather masks on pegs, a door at the end glowing faintly silver in the mist. Light: low lamplight from the upper left like faint gold spirit-light, a pale circle leaving her face half in shadow and her eyes dark. Expression: pale tired eyes with a faint wary tension, a slight downturn of the mouth and a deep pressed line across both cheeks.

people.imagined: At the stall he turns the pill-scale pendant in his fingers and greets a stranger like an old friend, with a very open grin.
people.subject: The moment: he leans forward over a stall counter with a wide friendly grin, turning a small brass pendant between his fingers. Face: a bright, round, open face with a wide grin showing a slightly crooked front tooth, quick shining brown eyes, thick eyebrows, ears that flare out like handles, a smooth chin and a few freckles across the cheekbones; a look of boyish ease. Hair: black, tied in a short high tail with a red silk cord. Body: lean and quick, lanky. Clothing: an outer disciple's simple graceful robe of vermilion silk with the cuffs rolled back neatly, a clean white inner collar, a modest standing collar with a thin line of gold flame embroidery, a pouch of red-stitched silk strapped across his chest. Hands and objects: a tiny brass pendant shaped like a two-pan scale hung on a cord, twirled in the right hand at chest height; a covered tray of small pill jars on the counter in front. Power: none. Background: a bright blurred market with lanterns and striped awnings of red and cream, a seller's round cart behind him with brass weights on it, glowing mist. Light: bright warm spirit-light from the upper left, a bright spark on the pendant and a warm glow on his teeth. Expression: ambitious, gregarious and deceitful; a friendly look that is just a little too wide.

people.imagined: A miner's son proud that he did not cough. He puffs his chest out at the word crusts, and his lips move as he repeats what he was told.
people.subject: The moment: standing very straight with his chest puffed out, he looks at the viewer with proud, simple eyes, lips moving as if repeating an instruction. Face (most important: the puffed chest and the proud open face): a wide, honest, slow face with a broad flat nose, round dark eyes, thick sandy brows dusted yellow, a broad slightly cleft chin, a large mouth pursed mid-word, sunburnt cheeks, yellowish dust on the forehead and ears red at the edges. Hair: coarse black hair, cut short and uneven, a red silk band across the brow. Body: stocky, broad, chest thrown out hard. Clothing: an outer disciple's vermilion silk robe a bit too small across the chest, the buttons straining and one hanging by a thread, a standing collar with a plain gold flame border, a plain grey under-robe, an oiled-silk over-vest stained yellow near the hem, thick fingerless gloves of oiled yellow silk. Hands and objects: one fist thumped on his own chest; in the other hand a small shovel-like wooden paddle held upright like a banner. Power: none; only a haze of pale yellow dust. Background: a pale yellow badland slope with a row of low sheds, heaps of sulphur crust in rough lumps and a wheelbarrow tipped on its side, mist low on the ground. Light: dusty golden spirit-light from the upper left, a faint yellow haze warming the whole picture. Expression: an earnest, simple face with chest-forward pride, round open eyes and a small tight smile, lips still shaping the words.

people.imagined: He tucks his shaking hands under his arms so no one sees; he is thinking of the pay he sends home.
people.subject: The moment: he stands with both hands tucked tightly under his folded arms, looking at the viewer with a faint, trusting, anxious smile. Face (most important: arms crossed with the hands hidden in the armpits, the shoulders hunched): a thin, mild, farm-boy face with round brown eyes, a slightly red snub nose, chapped lips, a few spots on the forehead, a soft hopeful mouth, hollow cheeks, a worried crease between the brows and a faint tremor in the line of the chin. Hair: brown, soft, short and sticking up. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, hunched. Clothing: a hand-me-down vermilion silk robe too big in the sleeves, the cuffs folded back twice, a patch on the left shoulder in a different red, a plain pale under-collar, a rope belt, a tiny knotted bag of coins on a cord at his neck sewn from a scrap of blue silk; the plainest version of the house's dress, kept clean. Hands and objects: both hands hidden, pressed under the opposite arms. Power: none. Background: a barley-field edge and a pale sky behind a trough shed, a narrow path leading down to low barley fields in the distance, a stack of ore baskets by the shed, mist in the hollows. Light: soft pearly spirit-light from the upper left, leaving his face slightly washed out and his eyes bright. Expression: a small, trying smile held over uneasy eyes, brows slightly raised and the jaw tight.

people.imagined: She leans on a spade in the barley field beside a new mound. Her face is weathered brown beyond her years, her hands square from digging.
people.subject: The moment: she stands with both hands on the handle of a spade planted in the earth, looking down at a new low mound and then up at the viewer, solemn. Face (most important: a weathered brown face, older than its years, and square spade-worn hands): a broad plain face weathered brown and chapped well before its time, strong cheekbones, calm dark eyes, a flat wide nose, a small frown line across the forehead, a firm straight mouth with chapped lips and a faint dust of earth at the temples. Hair: black, cut at the jaw, tied back with a plain cloth band. Body: stocky, broad shoulders and strong arms. Clothing: an outer disciple's plain, clean vermilion silk robe worn over a grey under-robe, faded from red to orange at the shoulders, sleeves rolled to the elbow, an oiled-silk over-vest with a mended tear, mud on the boots. Hands and objects: both big square hands gripping the handle of a flat-bladed iron spade stuck in the ground; behind her a small low grave mound with a plain wooden stake. Power: none. Background: golden barley fields and a low pale sky, a row of low mounds extending toward the horizon, each with a plain stake and a tuft of barley, soft mist. Light: soft late-afternoon spirit-light from the upper left, turning the barley gold and lengthening the shadow of the spade across the earth. Expression: a solemn, steady face with a sad downward mouth and weathered eyes that hold the viewer's gaze without flinching.

people.imagined: He balances the founder's meal tray up the stairs and laughs before the joke arrives, thumbs calloused from the tray.
people.subject: The moment: mid-laugh, he balances a lacquer meal tray on both palms and looks at the viewer with a wide grin, about to tell a joke before the joke has arrived. Face (most important: a big open laughing mouth in a very skinny face): a narrow, boyish face with sharp cheekbones, a wide mouth open in a laugh, bright dark eyes squeezed into crescents, a sharp chin, a long neck with a big Adam's apple, and a faint crease between the brows from habit. Hair: black, a short unruly tuft that will not lie flat, a red silk string tied round the brow. Body: very skinny and lanky, elbows stuck out to keep the tray level. Clothing: an outer disciple's graceful vermilion silk robe a little loose on his thin shoulders, the sleeves tied back above the elbow with string for work, a standing collar with a thin gold flame border, a white silk waist-cloth with a dark soup stain near the pocket, a red rope belt; the cloth is clean and good, only the waist-cloth shows the day's work. Hands and objects: a lacquer tray carrying a covered bowl and a tiny cup rests on the flat of both palms, his thumbs thick with callus along the rim; steam curls up from the bowl. Power: none. Background: a narrow wooden stair rising into the dark, a lantern hung from a nail, a second tray stacked on a shelf. Light: warm gold lantern spirit-light from the upper left, throwing his laughing shadow large on the wall. Expression: a sly, delighted mischief, the grin of a boy who is fond of everyone he serves and cannot resist teasing them.

people.imagined: Back from the hills with a basket of roots, scratched by the last bramble, he holds up a bunch of angelica for a girl he is courting.
people.subject: The moment: he holds up a bunch of pale-flowered angelica stalks, roots still dirty, toward the viewer and grins, back from the hills with a thin bramble scratch on his cheek, courting a girl with a gift of roots. Face (most important: a long red scratch across the left cheek, and soil under every nail): a handsome, sun-browned, restless face, a jaunty grin with cracked lips, quick brown eyes, slightly crooked brows, a little stubble with a leaf stuck in it, and a thin line of rust-red beads along the scratch. Hair: tousled brown hair with a twig caught in it. Body: lean, wiry and quick, leaning forward as he presents the flowers. Clothing: an outer disciple's vermilion silk robe of good cloth with a standing collar, a green silk scarf knotted at his neck, mud-caked boots from the hill, a woven basket on his back held by braided bark straps. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up the angelica, white umbels on long stalks with dirty roots; the fingernails are black with soil. Power: none; a few soft green motes drift off the flowers. Background: a hillside of mountain scrub, brambles and pale rock under a pale misty sky, a mountain eagle small in the distance. Light: bright hill spirit-light from the upper left, showing the dirt under his nails and the white umbels. Expression: a winning, restless grin with a flash of calculation behind it, the look of a young man who means every promise at the moment he makes it.

people.imagined: In the sealed room she reads the market prices aloud to the blind founder, a cord of her father's brass tags on her wrist. She is learning the ninth turn by smell.
people.subject: The moment: she kneels beside a low table and holds a covered bowl toward a dark doorway, turning her head to the viewer with a patient look. Face: a round, soft, honest face with full cheeks, gentle dark eyes, level brows, a small straight nose, a calm mouth, a mole on the chin and the faint dark circles of long nights; a tiny brass stud in each small ear. Hair: black, in a neat low bun held with a plain wooden pin. Body: round-shouldered and sturdy, kneeling upright. Clothing: an inner disciple's vermilion silk robe with a clean white inner collar, a standing collar with fine gold flames and a narrow band at each sleeve, the cuffs faintly stained red from the work, a plain pale waist-cloth, the sash tied in a double bow; no gloves. Hands and objects (the cord is the lead): on the left wrist a cord strung with six small brass tags, each stamped with a plain notch, jingling as she moves; both hands hold a lidded bowl with a wisp of steam. Power: none; a faint warm glow of steam and herb-haze. Background: a dim room with a curl of pale smoke at one side, a low table holding a small lamp and a row of covered bowls, the haze of herbs hanging in the air. Light: low warm spirit-light from the upper left, soft on her hands and the brass tags, a thin rim light on her cheek. Expression: a patient, cautious gentleness, brows slightly raised and the mouth closed, the honest look of someone who keeps careful count of everything and means no harm.

people.imagined: In a pressed collar, clean among the grey faces, he signs a ledger with ink-stained fingers and glances up bored.
people.subject: The moment: he leans back in a chair with a brush in his inked fingers and gazes at the viewer with idle self-satisfaction. Face (most important: the crisp pressed white collar and a town-clean look): a smooth pale young face, a well-shaped nose, neatly shaped eyebrows, half-lidded bright eyes, an arrogant arched brow, slightly full lips in a slight sneer, clear skin with a faint town-bred paleness, not one speck of dust on him. Hair: black and glossy, combed into a neat top-knot with a jade pin. Body: slim, easy, slouched. Clothing: an outer disciple's vermilion silk robe of the finest cloth, freshly pressed, with a hand's breadth of crisp white inner collar folded sharply, a standing collar with gold flame embroidery, sleeves lined in pale cream silk, a silk sash with a gold clasp, clean pale boots, a small silver ring on the left forefinger. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a brush, the fingertips and side of the hand stained with black ink; a small abacus on the desk beside. Power: none. Background: a tidy desk with a cup of fine thin porcelain tea, a fan, a brass paperweight and a stack of blank sheets, neat rows of boxes on the shelf behind, soft mist. Light: soft clean spirit-light from the upper left that makes his robe seem almost bright against the dusty room, a fine rim light on the jade pin. Expression: half-lidded, bored eyes and a faint self-satisfied curl of the lips, the chin tipped back and the whole face at ease.

people.imagined: Memorial of the co-founder at the furnace in 1141, brave and impatient, teaching the furnace to a young woman, the room behind her filling with fume.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of the founder, an older woman at a furnace turning to the viewer with a generous, impatient look. Face: a broad, strong, warm face weathered by the diggings, with wide cheekbones, thick brows, bright dark eyes, a big mouth in a half-smile, deep laugh lines and a faint red dusty tint at the cheeks. Hair: long black with grey streaks, tied in a bold high knot with a plain red silk cord and a simple red jade crown-pin. Body: broad and strong, square-shouldered, a woman who has lifted crucibles all her life. Clothing: the founder's long vermilion silk robe with a stiff standing collar embroidered with gold furnace flames, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a crimson brocade over-vest darkened at the edges by years at the fire, long gloves of oiled yellow silk, a cloth mask pulled down below the chin. Hands and objects: the right hand holds long iron tongs lifting a small round crucible glowing orange; the left is raised, palm out, as if telling someone to hurry. Power: a warm ochre-gold aura, faded like old paint, with sparks rising from the crucible. Background: a dim furnace room with a painted canopy of nine small stars above and faint smoke rising, a young woman's shape half seen at the edge, learning at her side. Light: orange furnace glow from the lower right, fading toward old-silk yellow at the edges of the painting, cracks like old lacquer across the surface. Expression: a generous, impatient half-smile, the eyes bright and a little bossy, a teacher who has given the same command a hundred times and loves the pupil for it.
